title: Principal Package Management Spec
description: Job Overview Principal Package Management Specialist utilizes their technical acumen, commercial acumen, management skills, and leadership skills to oversee all aspects of delivering a package from the cradle to the grave. Their core responsibility is ensuring the package is delivered on budget and on schedule while abiding by Quality, Health, Safety, Environment, and Security (QHSES) and project requirements. A successful Principal Package Management Specialist identifies risks and opportunities, sets up mitigation and captures plans accordingly. This entails developing a strategic outlook for the package and ensuring that all matters are resolved with the involvement of the right stakeholders and in a timely fashion. Principal Package Management Specialist must report status and outlook at an executive level to the Project Management team and, at times, Corporate Management. Responsibilities Deliver a package (purchase orders and/or subcontracts) on budget and schedule, and abide by QHSES and project requirements; complexity, criticality, and value of packages typically vary and are assigned and adjusted at the discretion of the function and project. Maintain a clear and thorough dialogue with the Project Management Team, and provide accurate and periodic status updates as well as both short and long-term outlooks. Identify risks and opportunities, and maintain a strategic outlook throughout the execution of the package; such discussion is to be held periodically with the Project Management team for buy-in. Maintain an accurate account of the package cost, commitments, changes, and forecast. Provide inputs and ensure alignment with Project Controls on current and forecasted cost and schedule. ROS dates to be analyzed with the schedulers to identify priorities and, if applicable, Installation Work Packages and Advance Work Packages to be set up and implemented. Track cost and schedule bid basis against actuals. Interface with all stakeholders to achieve package goals; stakeholders include but are not limited to the Supplier/Subcontractor, Engineering, Supply Chain, QHSES, Construction, Installation (if applicable), Commissioning, Joint Venture Partners, and, as needed, the client. Arrange and attend periodic status meetings with suppliers and clients as required. Manage formal correspondence with suppliers, clients, and other involved parties. Attend key meetings such as the progress meeting, kick-off meeting, PIM, and others. Oversee and enforce all day-to-day applicable processes involved and interface across various functions to identify and resolve any technical or commercial matters, and if unavoidable, then resolve any bottlenecks. Enforce the Management of Change process and Project Change Notices. Oversee the documentation process and manage priorities to ensure the most effective delivery from a cost and schedule aspect; this conversation must be coordinated between the suppliers, McDermott, and the client as applicable. Review key documents such as Technical Bid Evaluations, Commercial Bid Evaluations, Purchase Orders, and supplier data. Work with the end user to ensure alignment and expectations are met. Ensure that the prime contract flow downs are correctly administered, including variations. Oversee the planning, performance, and resource allocation of their team throughout the project. Could potentially report to the Package Manager or Senior Package Manager on a project. Develop and maintain contingency planning and lessons learned. Qualifications Bachelor’s Degree (or equivalent) in Engineering or Supply Chain Management (or a relevant discipline). 8-12 years of relevant experience (ideally in Engineering, Project/Package Management, Manufacturing, or similar). Technical knowledge of all phases of an Engineering, Procurement, Construction, and Installation (EPCI) project and specific knowledge in the domain of the proposed packages is preferred. Commercial knowledge of contracts, purchase orders, and relevant disciplines within the Supply Chain function, such as proposals, purchasing, expediting, logistics, and material management. Strong understanding and adherence to QHSES requirements and ability to ensure compliance. Understands the requisitioning process from the bid stage through clarifications until Purchase Order award and post-award activities such as execution, receiving, and commissioning. Proactive attitude in determining opportunities and risks, particularly those attributed to Quality, Safety, Budget, and Schedule. Characteristics of a leader that naturally relates to all members of the team, from the floor to the project team and executive management. Effective communicator with strong written, verbal, and public speaking skills. Willing to travel to various locations such as the shops, supplier offices and headquarters, job sites, labs, and other relevant locations as needed; at times, there may be a requirement for an extended deployment at a supplier’s location or the job site. PMP and/or PE is a plus. #J-18808-Ljbffr

The Staff Security Engineer is expected to bring a demonstrated history of delivering consequential security programs — including programs that encountered setbacks — and the technical judgment that only sustained, hands‑on experience in the domain produces. Critically, this role requires a security engineering philosophy grounded in business enablement: the conviction that security done well accelerates what the organization can do, not merely protects it. This means rigorously distinguishing between controls that reduce real risk and those that create the appearance of compliance without reducing exposure, taking genuine ownership of outcomes rather than delegating accountability through policy, and continuously questioning inherited assumptions about what security measures are necessary, sufficient, or proportionate. What You’ll Be Responsible For Defining, communicating, and executing a multi-year security strategy (especially in the IAM field) aligned with the organization's risk posture, regulatory obligations, and business objectives across multiple countries and regulatory jurisdictions. Designing and maintaining the core identity infrastructure with the durability and operational discipline required at organizational scale: enterprise Identity Provider, PKI and X.509 certificate lifecycle automation, mutual TLS for service‑to‑service authentication, and credential management systems engineered to remain sound as the organization grows. Translating least‑privilege access from a principle into a measurable, organization‑wide program — with defined metrics, visible adoption curves, and accountability structures that allow Security and Engineering leadership to track and act on the organization's access risk posture over time. Designing and maintaining a security engineering framework — comprising technical mechanisms, policies, incentives, and assurance processes — that ensures security properties are durable, verifiable, and operationally sound, rather than dependent on individual vigilance or periodic audits. Leading technical incident response for identity and access security events, including critical vulnerabilities in remote access infrastructure, ensuring thorough investigation, documented root cause analysis, and structural improvements that reduce the likelihood and impact of recurrence. Designing and facilitating large‑scale preparedness exercises grounded in realistic attack paths — involving engineering, operations, and executive functions — to identify genuine gaps in IAM controls, not merely satisfy a compliance requirement. Providing technical mentorship and coaching to senior engineers; lead innovative projects with universities and actively collaborate in hiring and career decisions in order to maintain a high technical standard throughout the safety organization. Serving as the technical authority in engagements with Legal, Compliance, internal audit, and external regulators on matters related to identity, authentication, and access control. We Are Looking for a Person Who Has Must-have +15 years of professional experience in security engineering, with a concentration in identity, authentication, or access management. Demonstrated track record of leading complex, multi-year security programs from conception through measurable outcome — including programs that required navigating organizational obstacles, technical constraints, or material mid‑course corrections. Expert‑level knowledge of IAM and authentication protocols: OIDC, OAuth 2.0, SAML 2.0, FIDO2/WebAuthn, mTLS, and Public Key Infrastructure (PKI). Proficiency in software engineering: ability to produce, review, and reason about production‑quality code in at least one general‑purpose programming language. Demonstrated ability to model identity‑related threat scenarios, assess attacker techniques relevant to the IAM surface, and design controls that remain effective under adversarial conditions. A demonstrable commitment to security as an organizational capability that enables business outcomes: a track record of solving real security problems, a disposition to challenge inherited security assumptions, and a clear pattern of distinguishing genuine risk reduction from security theater or responsibility transfer. Experience communicating technical risk assessments and strategic recommendations to senior non‑technical stakeholders, including executives and regulators. Nice-to-have Experience operating within a financial services institution or similarly regulated environment subject to multiple concurrent regulatory frameworks. Hands‑on experience administering or integrating with an enterprise Identity Provider at scale, particularly Okta, or Keycloak. Experience designing and enforcing security controls for third‑party, BPO, or partner environments without direct operational control of the partner's infrastructure. Experience leading organizational adoption of Zero Trust architecture, including authentication and authorization mechanisms for hybrid and multi‑cloud environments. Contributions to the broader security community — published research, conference presentations, open‑source tooling, or participation in standards bodies. title: Digital Product Manager
description: Job Overview FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”), that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Position The FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ Digital Product Manager will be the driving force behind FIFA’s digital direct-to-consumer experiences for FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. Whilst the role will be based in Rio, the successful candidate will act as an integral member of the global Product & Design team, defining fans’ digital journey across FIFA’s owned and operated platforms, notably including FIFA.com and FIFA’s official mobile app. Reporting to Head of Brand & Marketing, the primary responsibility will involve taking the lead in evolving FIFA’s fan-facing websites and apps specifically for FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027. This will include developing digital activations that support tournament goals and objectives, as well as delivery of commercial value for FIFA’s partners. Key Responsibilities Strategic Vision: Play a leading role in defining and developing FIFA’s digital consumer-facing proposition, specifically ensuring products and experiences reflect local fan behaviours and consumption habits, as well as aligning cultural nuances and emerging trends across Brazil and South America. Fan Engagement: Support FIFA’s audience growth goals by optimizing acquisition, engagement and retention journeys across owned platforms, as well as contributing to first-party data strategies. Value Generation: Partner closely with Commercial and Marketing teams to develop scalable digital activations and integrations that deliver measurable value to fans and partners alike. Tournament Planning & Delivery: Become an integral enabler of tournament-time digital operations, delivering high-traffic match moments, live content publishing, rapid issue resolution and cross-functional coordination during competition periods. Collaboration: Operate as an integral member of Digital Delivery, working alongside Product Managers located across Europe and acting as the department’s key representative within FIFA27. Governance & Communication: Providing clear, consistent updates to senior management and key stakeholders. Participation in cross-functional steering groups to maintain a balance between critical tournament milestones and product scope delivery. Drive Innovation: Champion a consumer-first mindset; exploring opportunities for innovation and application of AI-driven solutions to enhance content personalization and discovery, improve operational efficiency and create new fan engagement experiences that resonate with fans globally and locally. Data-driven Performance: Establish and track key performance indicators, using a blend of behavioural insights and user research to inform product development priorities, optimise product performance and exceed tournament goals and objectives. Education & Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in computer sciences, business management or related discipline. Relevant product development philosophies, e.g. Agile, are essential. Relevant project management qualifications, e.g. PRINCE2, highly beneficial. Work Experience 5+ years of product management experience, demonstrating end-to-end experience across the digital product lifecycle; from UX/UI design and roadmap development to rigorous testing and release management. Experience working in a direct-to-consumer business, ideally within sports, media or related industries. Experience leading complex projects will be highly beneficial, demonstrating aptitude for balancing personal development of others with empowerment to “get the job done”. Exceptional communication skills - both written and verbal – to succinctly and confidently interact with a wide range of stakeholders up to and including senior FIFA management. Demonstrable experience working autonomously and/or with ambiguity; with an ability to adapt swiftly to organisational change or leverage short-term opportunities. Competencies Confidence leading multiple projects with autonomy, often with colleagues and/or suppliers located in different territories and time zones. Passion for developing consumer experiences and thinking big picture; complemented with a demonstrable understanding of digital product development and design principles. Data-driven with an aptitude for harnessing data, forming KPIs, and leveraging consumer insights to make informed decisions. Comfortable working with senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams across FIFA, each with varying degrees of digital maturity and technical understanding. Willingness to travel to other FIFA offices and venues, typically in Zurich, as well as relocating to another location for a period of time, e.g. during FIFA Women’s World Cup in 2027. Languages Fluent in Portuguese and English. Proficiency in another official FIFA language, such as Spanish, is a benefit. Technology Strong knowledge of digital direct-to-consumer ecosystems, including mobile and video. Solid understanding and passion for digital innovation, including application of AI. Experience with industry-standard solutions, e.g. Figma, Asana and Confluence. Requirements Right to work in Brazil. Ability to relocate to Rio de Janeiro. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: MECHANICAL ENGINEER
description: GA Drilling is developing next-generation drilling technologies to unlock geothermal energy at depths and in conditions that conventional drilling cannot reach economically. Our mission is to make geothermal a scalable, baseload source of clean power by enabling reliable, efficient drilling in hard, hot rock. With engineering teams in the USA, Brazil, the UK, and across Europe, we are progressing rapidly toward commercial deployment of our technologies. We are seeking a mechanical engineer with a practical bias to perform mechanical design for downhole drilling systems and associated equipment related to assembly, testing, and maintenance. The ideal candidate will be equally comfortable working with established processes and procedures or helping to develop and refine new ones. You will be based at our Brazil office in Rio de Janeiro. Opportunity for you You will be a core member of the operations team, working closely with Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and Quality & Compliance to ensure drilling tools are produced, deployed, and maintained. You will have the opportunity to positively impact technology and processes as we move from prototype builds to commercial operations. Responsibilities Mechanical Design & Analysis Perform mechanical design and analysis of components and systems for drilling technologies and associated tooling and test equipment. Develop high-fidelity, multi-domain (hydraulic, mechanical, control) dynamic models of actuation systems using tools such as Simscape and MATLAB/Simulink. Perform stress calculations and analyze the impact of drilling fluid properties (viscosity, density, temperature) on hydraulic performance and response time, and use engineering judgement to recommend suitable design solutions. Generate high-quality engineering documentation — drawings, calculations, procedures, and reports — and contribute to design reviews, technical risk management, and equipment integration and commissioning. Assembly, Testing & Field Support Assist with equipment assembly, disassembly, maintenance, repair, and testing, including creating and refining the associated processes and procedures. Diagnose and repair equipment failures, support failure reporting, and work with Engineering, Manufacturing, and Quality & Compliance to elevate and resolve technical or quality issues. Provide hands‑on support during builds, tests, and field deployments, and travel to field locations when required. Support manufacturing, supply chain, and external suppliers to ensure seamless equipment deployment, and assist with project requirements, budgeting, timelines, and specifications. Support a positive and proactive HSE culture, adhere to HSE regulations and quality procedures, and help maintain a safe, organized work environment (5S, housekeeping, waste segregation). What we expect from you Experience & Technical Domain Knowledge 5+ years of mechanical engineering experience, ideally within advanced engineering for complex industrial product development environments. Strong grounding in mechanical engineering fundamentals, with experience in component design and manufacturing for industrial equipment. Proficiency with computer-aided design and analysis applications (CAD, CFD, FEA). Design justification experience via analysis and calculation — FEA, stress, and thermal calculations. Working knowledge of relevant mechanical engineering standards and legislation. Experience with equipment troubleshooting and report generation for complex mechanical or electromechanical systems. Ability to work in both Portuguese and English. Strong problem‑solving, analytical, and critical thinking skills, with the ability to read technical documentation, drawings, and engineering specifications. Customer Interface & Cross-Functional Collaboration Experience working with Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Quality & Compliance, and external suppliers to support equipment builds, deployments, and resolution of technical issues. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate field and test observations into clear, actionable engineering feedback. Execution, Testing & Operational Excellence High attention to detail, accuracy, and documentation discipline across drawings, calculations, procedures, and reports. Demonstrated ability to work independently or as part of a team, executing project plans from high-level direction and delivering reliably against schedule and milestones. Pragmatic decision‑maker, able to weigh business priorities and contribute to root cause analysis, corrective actions, and continuous improvement driven by test and field results. Ability to balance speed and rigor in fast-moving, technically challenging environments. Professional Mindset & Working Style Hands‑on, practical mindset with a strong bias toward action and problem solving. Comfortable on the shop floor, in test environments, and at field locations as required, including travel. Strong safety and quality focus, equally comfortable working with established processes or helping to develop and refine new ones. Adaptable, resilient, and effective in early‑stage and transitioning‑to‑commercial technology environments. Ability to provide and receive constructive, technically grounded feedback that improves product performance and reliability. Nice to have BSc or MSc in Mechanical Engineering or a related discipline. Familiarity with electromechanical fundamentals and the assembly, maintenance, and testing of complex electromechanical systems. Experience with hydraulics, and with drilling tool design. Interest in geothermal energy, drilling systems, or high-temperature downhole environments. What we offer: Opportunity to develop unique and innovative technological solutions which have the potential to change the world. The satisfaction of solving challenges associated with making ultra-deep geothermal energy a commercial reality. Be part of an experienced, global and highly motivated team. Collaborate with the world’s top industry players. Competitive industry compensation & benefits. #J-18808-Ljbffr

description: GA Drilling is developing next-generation drilling technologies to unlock geothermal energy anywhere on Earth. Look ahead at validation requirements, and develop and execute test plans and setups using both firmware and hardware debugging tools. Testing, Validation & Field Support Conduct prototype board bring-up, functional testing, and performance analysis. Troubleshoot electronic faults at the component and system level using diagnostic tools such as oscilloscopes, multimeters, and spectrum analyzers. Provide technical support to field service technicians and on-site drilling crews to resolve operational problems. Collaborate across mechanical, firmware, systems, and project teams on product development, testing, and failure analysis. Support a positive and proactive HSE culture and ensure that all activities adhere to HSE policy. What we expect from you Experience & Technical Domain Knowledge 5+ years of power electronics engineering experience, ideally within advanced engineering for complex industrial product development environments. Experience with high-voltage transmission and protection, and motor control electronic circuits (motor drivers, position feedback) used in oil & gas drilling, electric actuators, automation systems, electric vehicles, and similar applications. Experience with DC-DC converters (Buck/Boost, Flyback) used in power supplies across industrial and consumer electronics, including permanent downhole installations for oil & gas. Experience with analog and digital filters used across transmission networks, radio, satellite, medical devices, and oil & gas sensors and signal monitoring. Experience with sensors found in industrial and commercial electronics, including permanent downhole installations for oil & gas. Proficiency with electronics simulation and CAD tools used to model, simulate, and design electronic devices. Ability to work in both Portuguese and English. Strong analytical thinking and ability to read technical documentation, schematics, and engineering specifications. Customer Interface & Cross-Functional Collaboration Experience working directly with operations teams, field service technicians, and on-site drilling crews to support testing, deployments, and resolution of operational problems. Strong communication skills, with the ability to translate field and test observations into clear, actionable engineering feedback. Execution, Testing & Operational Excellence Strong attention to detail with a disciplined approach to testing, documentation, and configuration control. Demonstrated ability to work independently, execute project plans from high-level direction, and deliver reliably against schedule and milestones. Experience contributing to root cause analysis, corrective actions, and continuous improvement driven by test and field results. Ability to balance speed and rigor in fast-moving, technically challenging environments. Professional Mindset & Working Style Hands-on, practical mindset with a strong bias toward action and problem solving. Comfortable working in the lab, on the shop floor, in test environments, and in the field as required, including occasional travel. Strong safety and quality focus, with respect for procedures while helping evolve them as systems mature. Adaptable, resilient, and effective in early-stage and transitioning-to-commercial technology environments. Ability to provide and receive constructive, technically grounded feedback that improves product performance and reliability. Nice to have BSEE or MSEE preferred. Experience with embedded firmware development for high-voltage or motor control applications. Exposure to oil & gas, drilling, or downhole electronics qualification standards. Interest in geothermal energy, drilling systems, or high-temperature downhole environments. What we offer: Opportunity to develop unique and innovative technological solutions which have the potential to change the world. The satisfaction of solving challenges associated with making ultra-deep geothermal energy a commercial reality. Be part of an experienced, global and highly motivated team. Collaborate with the world’s top industry players. Competitive industry compensation & benefits. #J-18808-Ljbffr

Os principais projetos relacionados a esta posição são a fabricação de skids de processo, módulos offshore e vasos de pressão, incluindo o fornecimento de instrumentos, válvulas e materiais de E&I por fornecedores. Revisar especificações, códigos e normas aplicáveis da indústria (NR, ASME, AWS, ISO, API, entre outras) em relação aos requisitos do projeto. Liderar melhorias de processos, incluindo investigação de causa raiz e implementação de ações corretivas e preventivas. Desenvolver, implementar e manter especificações do cliente e requisitos regulatórios brasileiros, bem como a documentação da qualidade. Desenvolver, revisar e aprovar documentos de fornecedores, como ITPs, procedimentos de fabricação e END, relatórios de END, etc. Coordenar com fornecedores as inspeções e a compilação de documentos (MDB). Gerenciar o processo de NCR (Relatório de Não Conformidade) de fornecedores. Comunicar ativamente problemas e gargalos ao time de Gerência de projetos e Supply Chain. Executar tarefas e projetos especiais conforme designado pelo PSL e pelo RQM. Capturar lições aprendidas durante a execução das atividades e recomendar treinamentos necessários ou fornecer feedback ao projeto e aos fornecedores para implementação. Garantir que todas as mudanças de escopo sejam devidamente gerenciadas, implementadas e reportadas. Engajar fornecedores em processos de melhoria contínua, incluindo avaliação de novos fornecedores e auditorias periódicas em fornecedores existentes (planejamento, preparação, execução, reporte de resultados e acompanhamento da eficácia das ações corretivas). Requisitos e Qualificações Formação superior em Engenharia. Experiência como Engenheiro(a) de Qualidade, Manufatura, Fabricação ou Soldagem, ou equivalente, Inspetor(a) / Supervisor(a) da Qualidade. Conhecimento de normas para projeto de equipamentos de processo para o setor de óleo e gás. Conhecimento de requisitos de inspeção e Ensaios Não Destrutivos. Experiência com ferramentas e técnicas da Qualidade. Inglês avançado. Diferenciais Experiência em ambientes industriais de médio a grande porte, com processos de usinagem, soldagem e montagem de skids, módulos offshore e vasos de pressão, Ensaios Não Destrutivos e inspeções especiais, além de jateamento e pintura/revestimento. Qualificação como Auditor Interno. Histórico comprovado de melhoria de desempenho em Qualidade. Capacidade de criar requisitos de qualidade alinhados aos critérios de projeto. Capacidade de leitura e interpretação de PFDs e P&IDs complexos. Conhecimento de diferentes materiais de construção. Conhecimento das normas ASME Seção VIII Divisão 1, AWS D1.1 e ASME B31.3. Experiência em vasos de pressão e soldagem estrutural. Certificação CWI (desejável). Certificação NACE (desejável). Certificação de Inspetor de Soldagem Nível 1 ou 2 (AWS, FBTS ou CSWIP) – desejável. The role ensures that all safety and security personnel — including direct hires and supplier staff — meet defined competence, licensing and readiness standards prior to deployment. The position establishes structured training frameworks, certification processes and exercise programmes to ensure operational preparedness across stadiums and non‑competition sites. The role supports the creation of a sustainable safety and security legacy in Brazil through structured upskilling and professionalisation of the workforce. Responsibilities Conduct a comprehensive market capability and capacity analysis to identify gaps and risks related to the provision of staffed safety and security services Identify applicable qualification, certification and licensing criteria within Brazil and its federal states relevant to guarding, stewarding, close protection and related disciplines Design and implement a bespoke capability‑building strategy for internal staff and external security suppliers Design and deliver security training programmes tailored to specific roles (e.g. security guards, stewards, supervisors, managers, TSLOs/RSLOs and direct hires) Develop and implement a structured training curriculum and training materials aligned with the Safety & Security Strategy and Operational Plan Design, develop and implement analogue and digital training solutions, including instructor‑led programmes, workshops and e‑learning packages, ensuring scalable, accessible and role‑specific learning delivery across all safety and security personnel Define readiness criteria and certification processes for safety and security personnel prior to deployment Establish systems to track workforce competence, training completion and deployment readiness across all official tournament sites Coordinate and oversee joint exercises, table‑top simulations, venue rehearsals and scenario‑based drills to test operational response and inter‑agency coordination Design and implement programmes to ensure compliance with statutory qualification and licensing standards on site, including the development of quality control audit processes Engage with safety and security suppliers to ensure that capability‑building programmes are delivered effectively and that all personnel are trained before commencing work Coordinate with other FWWC2027 functional areas to ensure alignment on policies, procedures and response protocols Oversee the delivery and evaluation of drills, simulations and readiness exercises to ensure operational effectiveness Identify training gaps and implement corrective actions through continuous improvement processes Conduct on‑site quality control audits to verify training completion, certification and operational competence Support senior management and site management in verifying training‑related supplier invoices and compliance documentation YOUR PROFILE Education University degree in security management, education and training, public safety, risk management or a related field Professional training qualification or certification (e.g. instructional design, adult learning, security training accreditation) is desirable Experience Minimum 5 years of experience in safety and security training, workforce readiness or operational preparedness roles Demonstrated experience designing and delivering structured training programmes in large‑scale operational environments Experience coordinating exercises, simulations and multi‑agency readiness activities Familiarity with Brazilian licensing and qualification requirements in the security sector Experience working with public security authorities and private security suppliers Skills & Competencies Strong instructional design and training delivery capability Structured and analytical approach to readiness measurement and workforce tracking Excellent organisational and project management skills Ability to coordinate complex multi‑stakeholder exercises and rehearsals Strong leadership and stakeholder engagement capability Clear written and verbal communication skills Advanced IT proficiency including MS Office suite, particularly Excel, PowerPoint and Word Certifications & Requirements Right to live and work in Brazil Willingness to travel nationally and work extended hours during tournament periods Fluency in Portuguese and English (spoken and written) is essential #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: MECHANICAL TECHNICIAN
description: GA Drilling is developing next-generation drilling technologies to unlock geothermal energy anywhere on Earth. Our mission is to make geothermal a globally scalable, baseload source of clean power by enabling access to hard, hot rock at depths and temperatures that conventional drilling cannot reach economically. Our work demands mastery across electronics, hydraulics, mechanics, systems, and control to create products that survive and perform in harsh, high-temperature, high-load downhole conditions. We are seeking a mechanical technician with 3+ years' experience in lab and field testing of mechanical and electromechanical equipment for downhole drilling systems, including assembly, prototyping, operating, and debugging the associated test equipment. You will be based at our Brazil office in Rio de Janeiro. The opportunity for you You will own the hands‑on assembly, testing, and maintenance of mechanical and electromechanical equipment for our downhole drilling systems — running functional and performance tests in the lab and supporting prototype bring‑up, qualification campaigns, and operational deployments in the field. You will work alongside mechanical, electrical, and systems engineers, capturing test data and feeding it back into design and reliability improvements. Responsibilities Conduct functional tests, performance evaluations, and calibrations on mechanical and electromechanical equipment to ensure compliance with quality standards and manufacturer specifications. Set up and operate test equipment — pressure and temperature test rigs, hydraulic test benches, torque tools, dimensional metrology (calipers, micrometers, dial indicators), and data acquisition systems — to run characterization, qualification, and acceptance testing. Diagnose and repair mechanical and hydraulic failures at the component and assembly level, including disassembly, inspection, replacement of worn or damaged parts, and rework of seals, fasteners, and fittings. Support prototype bring‑up and design iterations by capturing test data, flagging anomalies, and feeding observations back to mechanical and systems engineers. Assembly, Field Support & Documentation Assemble, disassemble, inspect, and perform preventative maintenance on mechanical and hydraulic equipment (downhole tools, actuators, drillstring components, pumps, valves, and associated test fixtures) according to technical specifications and procedures. Maintain accurate service records, calibration logs, and repair documentation, and generate clear reports on work performed and equipment status. Provide hands‑on support to field representatives and drilling crews during qualification campaigns and deployments, and travel to field locations when required. Coordinate with other technicians, engineers, and field representatives to resolve complex issues, support failure analysis, and ensure seamless equipment deployment. Help maintain an organized work environment and manage inventory of electronic components, parts, and supplies. Support a positive and proactive HSE culture, adhere to HSE regulations and quality procedures, and help maintain a safe, organized work environment (5S, housekeeping, waste segregation). What we expect from you Experience & Technical Domain Knowledge 3+ years of experience working with mechanical and hydraulic equipment, preferably in an industrial or oilfield environment. Technical school certificate in mechanical technology, mechatronics, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience. Proficiency with mechanical and hydraulic test equipment (pressure and temperature rigs, torque tools, hydraulic benches), dimensional metrology instruments (calipers, micrometers, dial indicators), and hand and power tools. Skilled in mechanical assembly and disassembly, including torque‑controlled fastening, seal and o‑ring installation, and alignment of rotating and reciprocating components. Ability to read, understand, and interpret technical manuals, drawings, schematics, blueprints, and engineering instructions. Experience troubleshooting and repairing mechanical and hydraulic equipment and generating clear service and calibration reports. Ability to work in both Portuguese and English. Basic computer literacy and familiarity with data acquisition and diagnostic software, plus strong problem‑solving, analytical, and critical thinking skills. Customer Interface & Cross‑Functional Collaboration Experience working alongside engineers, field representatives, and drilling crews to support testing, deployments, and on‑site troubleshooting. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to capture lab and field test observations as clear, actionable feedback for engineering. Execution, Testing & Operational Excellence High attention to detail and discipline in service records, calibration logs, and repair documentation. Ability to work independently or as part of a team, executing assigned tasks reliably against schedule and procedures. Contributes to root cause analysis, corrective actions, and continuous improvement based on test and field results. Ability to balance speed and rigor in fast‑moving, technically challenging environments. Professional Mindset & Working Style Hands‑on, practical mindset with a strong bias toward action and problem solving. Comfortable on the shop floor, in the lab, and at field locations as required, including travel. Strong safety and quality focus, with respect for procedures while helping refine them as systems and processes mature. Adaptable and resilient in early‑stage and transitioning‑to‑commercial technology environments. Open to giving and receiving constructive feedback that improves equipment performance and reliability. Nice to have Associate degree or higher in mechanical technology, mechatronics, or a related discipline. Experience with downhole tools, drillstring components, or other oilfield mechanical equipment. Familiarity with calibration management systems and qualification testing standards. Interest in geothermal energy, drilling systems, or high‑temperature downhole environments. What we offer: Opportunity to develop unique and innovative technological solutions which have the potential to change the world. The satisfaction of solving challenges associated with making ultra‑deep geothermal energy a commercial reality. Be part of an experienced, global and highly motivated team. Collaborate with the world’s top industry players. Competitive industry compensation & benefits. #J-18808-Ljbffr

Comfort working in fast-moving, technically challenging environments while maintaining rigor in your work. title: Access Management Cluster Manager
description: Access Management Cluster Manager Department: Tournament and Venue Operations Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time Location: Brazil Description FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team. THE POSITION Reporting to the Access Management Senior Manager, you will be a key member of the FIFA WOMEN’S WORLD CUP 2027 Access Management team. You will be responsible for developing and implementing the Access Management operations for all the official venues across the tournament within Brazil, in line with Access Management policies and procedures. Through close coordination with other Functional Area (FA) and venue managers, you will ensure that the operations relating to the key movements of persons holding a FIFA access device into and within their official venues meets the requirements and provide efficient, safe, and well‑planned ingress, circulation & egress. The Access Management Cluster Manager will assist the Access Management Senior Manager by supporting the Access Management Venue Managers in the preparation stages of the tournament with the possibility of then assuming the position of Access Management Venue Manager of the Rio de Janeiro Stadium during the tournament. You will ensure security personnel and other responsible staff are provided with the necessary information, training and tools to operate access control effectively at each required location. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Oversight, training and support to the Access Management Venue Managers across all official venues including Stadia, Broadcast Centre, Venue Specific Hotels, and Training Sites. Implementation and operation of Access Management policies and procedures for accredited individuals in line with the accreditation and safety and security concepts for the tournament, including access control point setup and entitlement resolution. Planning and mapping of key client group flows, vertical transportation and ingress points onto venue maps and communication of flows and ingress points to all client groups via the provision of access tours, maps and briefings. Ensuring all client group flows, paths of travel, entrances and exits planned for people with disabilities and/or limited mobility meet FIFA and related local Accessibility standards and requirements. Provision of key wayfinding information as required to FIFA Dressing & Signage to ensure wayfinding on site is correct and as per all client group flows. Ensure that all wayfinding meets FIFA Accessibility standards and requirements. Facilitate additional and exceptional access requirements on site and assist all client groups with any access related issues. Ensuring all Functional Areas (FAs) at the venues can locate their working areas and know how to reach them, within the constraints of privilege zoning and restrictions. Ensuring all access staff and volunteers are trained and fully understand their roles and function and can perform the duties expected of them. YOUR PROFILE Education: Bachelor’s degree or similar level of higher education in IT & Systems, Sport Venue Management, Safety and Security or similar. If experience is compensating, lower degree is welcome to apply. Football access management knowledge. FIFA access management knowledge is a plus. Effective interpersonal communication, influencing and negotiation skills. Strong problem solving and analytical skills. Stature and professional experience necessary to interact as tough partner with senior colleagues. Good judgement, superb integrity, maturity, and fairness in dealing with people. Experience: Minimum experience of 2 years in the sport event industry, preferably within access management, accreditation, safety and security or venue management. Experience within FIFA is an advantage. Operation and setup of complex access control systems within ticketing and/or accreditation. Wayfinding and route planning in a stadium environment. Single-sport, multi-venue event experience. Management and leadership of a team in high pressure tournament operations. Demonstratable ability to manage multiple projects concurrently and under pressure. Requirements: Fluent in Portuguese and English. Right to work in Brazil. Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro. #J-18808-Ljbffr

Implementation and operation of Access Management policies and procedures for accredited individuals in line with the accreditation and safety and security concepts for the tournament, including access control point setup and entitlement resolution. Planning and mapping of key client group flows, vertical transportation and ingress points onto venue maps and communication of flows and ingress points to all client groups via the provision of access tours, maps and briefings. Ensuring all client group flows, paths of travel, entrances and exits planned for people with disabilities and/or limited mobility meet FIFA and related local Accessibility standards and requirements. Provision of key wayfinding information as required to FIFA Dressing & Signage to ensure wayfinding on site is correct and as per all client group flows. Ensure that all wayfinding meets FIFA Accessibility standards and requirements. Facilitate additional and exceptional access requirements on site and assist all client groups with any access related issues. Ensuring all Functional Areas (FAs) at the venues can locate their working areas and know how to reach them, within the constraints of privilege zoning and restrictions. Ensuring all access staff and volunteers are trained and fully understand their roles and function and can perform the duties expected of them. Effective interpersonal communication, influencing and negotiation skills. Strong problem solving and analytical skills. Stature and professional experience necessary to interact as tough partner with senior colleagues. Good judgement, superb integrity, maturity, and fairness in dealing with people. Experience: Minimum experience of 2 years in the sport event industry, preferably within access management, accreditation, safety and security or venue management. Experience within FIFA is an advantage. Operation and setup of complex access control systems within ticketing and/or accreditation. Wayfinding and route planning in a stadium environment. Single-sport, multi-venue event experience. Management and leadership of a team in high pressure tournament operations. Demonstratable ability to manage multiple projects concurrently and under pressure. Requirements: Fluent in Portuguese and English. Right to work in Brazil. Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro. #J-18808-Ljbffr

Proficiency in using Azure Synapse Analytics resources including Notebooks, Pipelines, Linked Services, and Azure Key Vault. Knowledge of data integration best practices and tools. Experience with version control systems, such as Git (Azure DevOps). Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with a keen attention to detail. Ensuring successful integration of the FWWC2027 air traffic into the overall international airline schedule. Participate proactively in the Airport/ Mobility Working Groups and ensure (via close collaboration with HC Transport, Civil Aviation and Airport Operators and Authorities) that the air traffic match the airports and terminal capacities. Ensuring integration of the Airport Operational Plan with the Airport Transportation Plan, as well as correlation with all other Transport services and operations. title: Profissional AI Specialist
description: A primeira coisa que você precisa saber é que aqui você não vai cair na rotina. A Radix desenvolve soluções para empresas de diferentes setores e indústrias. Como Profissional AI Specialist você vai: Atuar como referência técnica em soluções de Inteligência Artificial, apoiando a definição, arquitetura, desenvolvimento e evolução de aplicações baseadas em IA, incluindo IA generativa, modelos de linguagem, agentes inteligentes, automações cognitivas e soluções orientadas a dados. Atuar de forma colaborativa com equipes multidisciplinares, apoiando decisões técnicas, removendo impedimentos, orientando profissionais menos experientes e contribuindo para a disseminação de conhecimento sobre IA dentro da organização. Estimular a cultura de inovação, aprendizado contínuo e experimentação, identificando novas tecnologias, tendências e oportunidades de aplicação de Inteligência Artificial nos diferentes contextos de negócio da Radix. title: Senior Director
description: Requisition ID: 50092 Business Unit: Fitch Ratings Category: Credit Analysis & Research Location: São Paulo, BR; Rio de Janeiro, RJ, BR Senior Director, Latin American Corporates, Infrastructure & Project Finance (CIPF) – Energy, Power & Utilities We will Count on You To: Lead coverage of a portfolio across the Energy, Power & Utilities sectors in Latin America, with a particular focus on Brazil. Have direct managerial responsibility for analysts within the team, providing leadership, coaching, and development support while fostering a collaborative and high-performance culture. Oversee the analysis of key quantitative and qualitative factors influencing credit quality across corporates and project finance entities in the sector. Supervise the maintenance, and review of detailed financial models and credit analyses used to support rating recommendations. Chair and participate actively in internal rating committees, presenting clear and well-supported rating recommendations for both international and national scale ratings, where applicable. Serve as a senior point of contact for external market participants, including issuers, investors, bankers, advisors, and other stakeholders in the rating process. Articulate Fitch’s credit views, rating rationales, and sector outlook in a clear, engaging, and commercially aware manner through meetings, conference calls, written commentary, and published research. Contribute to the strategic direction and visibility of Fitch’s Latin America CIPF franchise , including representing Fitch in conferences, industry forums, and client events. Support the management of the regional portfolio across multiple regulatory environments, ensuring high analytical standards, consistency, and timeliness in rating actions and research output. Partner closely with colleagues across sectors, countries, and analytical groups to advance the One CIPF approach and strengthen Fitch’s market presence across Latin America. Write and oversee timely, insightful research on sector trends, market developments, and topical credit issues affecting the Energy, Power & Utilities space. Mentor and develop junior team members, helping to build analytical depth and succession within the franchise. What You Need to Have: 10+ years of relevant experience in credit analysis, project finance, capital markets, corporate or investment banking, or a related field. Strong knowledge of the Energy, Power & Utilities sectors, ideally including exposure to regulated utilities, power generation, transmission, renewables, and/or midstream or energy infrastructure assets. Demonstrated experience managing people and/or leading teams in an analytical environment. Solid understanding of financial statement analysis, credit fundamentals, and debt capital structures. Proven ability to assess and explain analytically complex topics with sound judgment and intellectual rigor. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences. Fluency in English and Portuguese required; Spanish strongly preferred. Bachelor’s degree required; MBA, master’s degree, CFA, CPA, or other advanced professional qualification preferred. Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality work in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment. Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build credibility with internal and external stakeholders. What Would Make You Stand Out: Deep knowledge of, and strong interest in, the Brazilian Energy, Power & Utilities sectors, with a desire to continue expanding expertise across related corporate and project finance subsectors. A strong professional background in capital markets and/or credit analysis, supported by well-developed financial statement analysis and credit assessment skills. Demonstrated interest in deepening exposure to and understanding of the debt capital markets, particularly as they relate to Latin American issuers and infrastructure assets. A clear pattern of leadership, with the ability to proactively and effectively engage with a wide range of stakeholders, both internally and externally. Presence, judgment, and communication skills to represent Fitch credibly with issuer management teams, investors, bankers, and market participants. A collaborative mindset and a strong commitment to mentoring junior analysts and contributing to the development of the broader team. #J-18808-Ljbffr

Maintain and regularly update the equipment master list to reflect current status and compliance details. Define testing, measurement, replacements, repairs, and modifications schedules based on written procedures, ensuring the physical condition of critical equipment meets operational safety requirements. Ensure rigorous verification and performance testing of safety valves and other safety‑critical equipment, either by performing, witnessing, or overseeing such tests to guarantee reliable operation. Conduct audits of equipment manufacturers as required, supporting thorough supplier qualification and quality assurance. Cost Control Experience: Apply cost control principles within offshore oil and gas projects to optimise expenditure without compromising safety or quality. Teamwork: Work collaboratively across multi‑disciplinary teams and with external partners, fostering a positive and productive working environment. Communication Skills: Communicate effectively at all organisational levels, both verbally and in writing, ensuring clarity and professionalism in all interactions. Analytical and Problem‑Solving Abilities: Use strong analytical skills to assess equipment conditions, interpret inspection data, and develop practical solutions. Attention to Detail: Maintain accuracy in documentation, procedures, and reporting to support compliance and operational excellence. Responsibility and Proactivity: Take ownership of tasks, demonstrate initiative, and work in a hands‑on manner to achieve targets and resolve issues promptly. Qualifications and Experience Engineering degreeis mandatory. CREA‑RJ accreditation is required. Post‑Graduation degree in a relevant field will be considered a strong advantage. Experience as an Operations Engineer within the Brazilian oil and gas sector, with experience specifically in integrity engineering preferred. Proven experience working with FPSO projects and offshore operations is highly desirable. Fluent English and Portuguese verbal and written communication skills to effectively liaise with diverse teams and stakeholders. Why Join Us? At Yinson Brasil Serviços Ltda, you will become part of a forward‑thinking and inclusive team dedicated to safe and sustainable offshore operations. We value initiative and provide opportunities for professional growth within a dynamic sector. Our collaborative culture encourages knowledge sharing and continuous improvement, enabling you to make a tangible impact in a challenging and rewarding environment. If you are a focused, detail‑oriented professional with a strong commitment to equipment integrity and operational safety, and you thrive in a team‑oriented setting, this role offers an excellent platform to advance your career in offshore production. benefício de todos, porque cada vez que cuidamos de uma pessoa, tornamos o mundo inteiro melhor.**Vaga**: Pessoa Coordenadora de Manutenção**Localidade:** Areal, RJPorque, se assim como nós, você é movido pelo desejo de cuidar de todos, prosperar em uma empresa com propósito e se juntar a um movimento que faz a diferença!Estamos em busca de um gestão estratégica e operacional da manutenção industrial, atuando no planejamento e execução de atividades preventivas, preditivas e corretivas para garantir disponibilidade e confiabilidade dos equipamentos.**A sua missão:*** Gerenciar o planejamento e a execução da manutenção preventiva, preditiva e corretiva dos equipamentos e instalações industriais;* Gerenciar as atividades da equipe de mantenedores visando maximizar a disponibilidade dos equipamentos e instalações industriais através da melhoria contínua dos processos;* Gerenciar a gestão das atividades de manutenção, através de softwares e planilhas especificas;* procedimentos com atividades e rotinas que assegurem o desempenho esperado dos equipamentos e instalações primando pela segurança operacional, garantia da qualidade do produto e preservação do meio ambiente;* Selecionar e contratar serviços de terceiros para consertos em equipamentos, mediante avaliação técnica com a relação custo/benefício;* Promover o treinamento e qualificação da equipe de mantenedores de manutenção;* Implantar as mudanças necessárias com solução para os problemas e tomada de decisão adequada;* Suporte na gestão do budget anual de despesas a através do desenvolvimento de fornecedores, controle de estoques de manutenção, redução de perdas, controle de recursos energéticos e telefonia;* Suporte na gestão de projetos de investimentos nas fases de definição de escopo, planejamento, execução, controle e avaliação dos resultados;* Definir e controlar metas e indicadores de desempenho da manutenção;* Elaborar documentação técnica, analisar relatórios, planejar intervenções, mapear riscos e recomendar reparo ou substituição dos equipamentos e instalações;* Assegurar a adoção de medidas corretivas para as situações de risco grave e iminente reportada pelos seus liderados, quando do uso do direito de recusa, previamente ao retorno da atividade.**Um pouco do que oferecemos:*** Vale-Transporte;* Refeição no local;* Plano de Saúde e Odontológico;* Wellhub;* motorista.Presente em 120 países com uma equipe de mais de 10.000 colaboradores, temos orgulho de criar impacto científico e humano, hoje e amanhã! title: Facility Engineer
description: Job Family: Operations and Technical Management Location: Santos, BR, Rio de Janeiro, BR, Purpose As a Facility Engineer, you are responsible for monitoring and ensuring the production of the units, with a focus on the monitoring of all topside equipment. This role also includes troubleshooting and conducting incident analysis for any issues that arise in the units. Additionally, you ensure that all processes and facilities adhere to company and industry standards, safety regulations, and environmental guidelines, while optimizing performance, reliability, and cost‑effectiveness. Responsibilities Ensure that the unit operates within design conditions, maintaining optimal performance and safety. Ensure all facilities and processes adhere to industry safety standards, environmental regulations, and company policies. Conduct regular safety audits, hazard assessments, and risk analyses, implementing corrective actions as needed to mitigate risks. Conduct and participate actively in investigations of incidents related to production loss and process safety, ensuring thorough analysis and follow‑up actions. Oversee the day‑to‑day operation of production facilities, ensuring optimal performance and reliability. Implement and maintain best practices in process management, maintenance, and operational procedures to minimize downtime and reduce operational costs. Provide technical support to offshore operations, including process monitoring using tools like PI, SEEQ, and daily reports. Lead and coordinate facility‑related projects from conceptualization to execution, ensuring timely delivery within budget. Assist in planning, organizing, and coordinating planned interventions in process equipment such as CO2 membranes, SRP membranes, mol sieves, and guard filters. Provide technical recommendations to offshore teams for process optimization, improvements, and best practices. Conduct technical meetings with offshore teams to address process deviations and implement coordinated actions. Participate in and support risk assessments (HAZOP, HAZID, ORA, TRA, SIL) and review action plans. Execute technical internal audits offshore and support audits such as SGSO, ANP, CONAMA, and PAG. Share lessons learned and disseminate technical best practices across the organization. Support offshore teams in ramp‑up/down planning and equipment preservation for shutdowns (SD). Define and execute a 3‑Year Plan (3YP) related to preventive facilities scope, supporting the P &F Lead and Technical Specialists in the 3YP budget exercise. Education Bachelor’s degree in an engineering discipline. Experience Chemical industry acting as process or production engineer. Project business focussed in process engineering. Oil and gas experience (desired). Experience in industry. Functional Competencies Process – Process System Engineering Integrity and Reliability Remote Surveillance and Monitoring – Learning from events Reliability, Operability and Safety – Incident Management Process – Process Equipment and Internals Design Troubleshooting – ICSS Process Control – Analysis and Planning Equal Employment Opportunity SBM Offshore is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and affirmative action employer. SBM Offshore does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, non‑disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need. #J-18808-Ljbffr

Em 2026, a companhia atravessa um ciclo decrescimento impulsionado por novos projetos estruturantes, operações de O&Me iniciativas de expansão (CAPEX), o que exige excelência em logística,comércio exterior, compliance regulatório e eficiência operacional em operaçõesde alta complexidade. Sobre aposição Buscamos um(a)Advogado(a) Sênior – Contencioso Estratégico e Arbitragem para atuar no time de Contencioso Estratégico e Arbitragem da Eneva,que conduz disputas judiciais e arbitrais de alto impacto e assessora as áreasinternas em temas que abrangem engenharia, projetos de infraestrutura,regulatório, societário, M&A, contratos, comercialização de energia e gás,seguros e garantias, recuperação de créditos, falência e recuperação judicial,O&M, E&P, financiamentos e mercado de capitais. A missão é atuarem frentes de alta complexidade, definir estratégias jurídicas e negociais e atuarcomo ponto focal de projetos e temas relevantes para a companhia. Principais responsabilidades Conduzir a estratégiaprocessual de disputas de alto impacto, incluindo análise de riscos,gestão de provas, documentos, testemunhas, audiências e perícias; Definir teses e atuar naestruturação de negócios jurídicos complexos; Elaborar pareceresexecutivos, notificações e acordos voltados à avaliação de riscos e àresolução e prevenção de litígios; Coordenar e monitorarescritórios de advocacia externos, validando estratégias, peças eposicionamentos técnicos; Atuar como elo entreáreas internas e assessores externos, coordenando interfacesmultidisciplinares; Elaborar materialexecutivo para deliberação pela alta administração. Requisitos e qualificações Formação Graduação em Direito com OAB ativa. Experiência e conhecimentos técnicos Experiência em arbitragens e processos judiciais complexos; Capacidade de estruturar negócios jurídicos como transações e negociações para evitar litígios; Leitura integrada entre o jurídico, o técnico e o operacional; Experiência consistente em contencioso cível estratégico e/ou arbitragem; Capacidade de conduzir disputas complexas com autonomia; Inglês avançado; Desejável pós-graduação em arbitragem, contencioso ou direito civil/empresarial; Desejável experiência no setor de energia ou infraestrutura. Competências comportamentais Influência positiva sobre o time e stakeholders Ser disponível e curioso para aprender Franqueza e praticidade para entregar o melhor resultado Não ter medo de colocar a mão na massa (ser hands on) Local de Trabalho Sede (Botafogo – Rio de Janeiro) Saiba mais sobre nós em: A Eneva é uma empresa séria e comprometida com a transparência em seus processosseletivos e não solicita qualquer tipo de pagamento durante o processo de seleção. Venha fazer parte do nosso time! Todas as nossas vagas são destinadas também a candidatos PcDs. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Líder de Projetos de Subsuperfície de Pesquisa e Tecnologia
description: Empresa empregadora TotalEnergies EP Brasil Ltda Domínio Pesquisa, Inovação e Desenvolvimento Tipo de contrato Contrato Duração Indeterminada (CDI) Experiência Mínimo 10 anos Context & Environment Manter total conformidade com os procedimentos da TotalEnergies e alinhamento com seus interesses e visão de longo prazo. Respeitar orçamentos e cronogramas, garantindo a eficiência de custos, bem como auditar e analisar eventuais desvios ou não conformidades. Representar a filial perante parceiros externos e organizações empresariais, sempre em alinhamento e respeitando os valores e a estratégia da TTE. Atividades Como Líder de Projetos de Subsuperfície de Pesquisa e Tecnologia, o(a) colaborador(a) deverá desempenhar suas atividades em conformidade com o Sistema de Gestão de HSE, alinhado aos Princípios One Maestro e orientado à proteção da integridade das pessoas, considerando a preservação do meio ambiente e dos recursos, por meio da contribuição para a melhoria da eficiência energética e a descarbonização dos ativos e da reputação da Companhia. Coordenar e direcionar programas de P&D relacionados a tecnologias selecionadas pela sede da TotalEnergies e pela TEPBR para apoiar as necessidades de Exploração & Produção. Essas tecnologias abrangem todos os domínios de Geociências — Geofísica, Geologia e Reservatórios — tanto para Óleo & Gás quanto para aplicações de Transição Energética, principalmente reservatórios para armazenamento de CO₂; Atuar como ponto focal técnico da afiliada para temas de geociências relacionados a CCS, assegurando a integração entre as disciplinas de Geologia, Geofísica e Reservatórios; Revisar, desafiar e validar os principais entregáveis técnicos relacionados a estudos e projetos pilotos de CCS, além de oferecer expertise e suporte às equipes de ativos, garantindo robustez e consistência dos estudos de subsuperfície em CCS; Assegurar interação eficaz com a rede global de P&D da TotalEnergies, incluindo participação em atividades de avaliação e qualificação, mantendo forte alinhamento com as equipes e programas OneTech P&D / TL / SRTP; Liderar programas de P&D em Geociências para CCS: identificar, propor e direcionar projetos de P&D voltados a desafios de subsuperfície em CCS, além de gerenciar sua execução, assegurando qualidade técnica, relevância, alinhamento com as prioridades do negócio e transferência eficaz dos resultados para as equipes operacionais. Manter forte interação com OneTech P&D, Houston CDR e parceiros de pesquisa, garantindo alinhamento com os programas globais de tecnologia; Atuar em interface com SGIs, Ativos e Parceiros, em estreita coordenação com Geologia, Geofísica e Reservatórios, assegurando alinhamento com o referencial técnico da Companhia e as melhores práticas. Apoiar equipes de ativos na integração de CCS nas avaliações de subsuperfície e estudos de desenvolvimento, contribuindo para posicionamentos técnicos alinhados com parceiros (ex.: Petrobras) em temas relacionados a CCS; Identificar, propor e desenvolver colaborações e projetos de P&D com universidades, laboratórios, institutos de pesquisa e fornecedores, garantindo forte alinhamento com as prioridades estratégicas da TotalEnergies. Inclui prospecção e maturação de conceitos inovadores voltados aos desafios futuros do negócio, com foco na implementação de pilotos estratégicos; Justificar e apoiar a submissão de novas propostas de projetos, além de avaliar anualmente os projetos em andamento quanto à continuidade de financiamento, com base no conteúdo técnico, qualidade das entregas e alinhamento com os objetivos de P&D. Contribuir para a preparação orçamentária e para o desenvolvimento de dossiês de financiamento (ex.: EMBRAPII); Gerenciar a execução de projetos operados, assegurando entregas no prazo, dentro dos orçamentos aprovados e com comunicação eficaz dos resultados aos stakeholders relevantes. Produzir relatórios de P&D de alta qualidade, incluindo sumários de reuniões, sínteses de conferências, notas técnicas, propostas de trabalho e planos de execução de projetos; Manter colaboração proativa e construtiva com a Petrobras em todas as atividades relacionadas ao STCA, incluindo novas iniciativas, projetos de P&D e trocas de conhecimento; Monitorar o desenvolvimento tecnológico externo proveniente de concorrentes, fornecedores e academia, garantindo que a liderança de P&D da TotalEnergies esteja informada sobre sua relevância e impacto potencial. Acompanhar tecnologias emergentes de geociências aplicadas a CCS, avaliar sua aplicabilidade ao portfólio TEP-Brasil e promover sua avaliação e implementação por meio de projetos de P&D ou pilotos; Compartilhar conhecimento e desenvolver competências: contribuir para o desenvolvimento das capacidades em geociências para CCS na afiliada. Apoiar treinamentos, disseminação de conhecimento e melhores práticas, além de facilitar a comunicação entre P&D, ativos e comunidades técnicas. Responsabilidades Manter total conformidade com os procedimentos da TTE e alinhamento com seus interesses e visão de longo prazo; Garantir a execução dos projetos conforme validado pela Diretoria de P&D e pelas principais partes interessadas; Assegurar a conformidade dos projetos com a regulamentação de P&D da ANP. Perfil do Candidato Formação: Doutorado (preferencial) ou Mestrado em Geologia, Geofísica ou em área correlata de Geociências. Experiência profissional: Experiência em P&D em E&P e/ou Gestão de Projetos, com foco em atividades de Geociências. Considerando que a posição abrange Geofísica, Geologia e Reservatórios, é essencial experiência prévia em equipes de Geociências de Exploração ou de Ativos, bem como em temas relacionados à transição energética, como CCS. Capacidade analítica comprovada, aliada a excelentes habilidades interpessoais, de comunicação (oral e escrita), organização e apresentação. Alinhamento com os valores da Companhia. Informações Adicionais #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Sr Software Engineer - Delivery - Rio de Janeiro
description: Please note: this hybrid position is based in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil - welcoming both local professionals and those open to relocating. About the Role The Tech Center in Brazil is expanding, and our teams in Core Services, Delivery are looking for talented Senior Software Engineers to join and contribute to our projects. You will work with global teams to develop products impacting millions of users worldwide, while supporting our platform teams in enhancing engineering processes. Here’s a closer look at each team: Core Services: This team builds the foundational infrastructure and platforms that power all of Uber’s products. As a member, you'll develop scalable, reliable, and reusable services that are critical to Uber's global operations. Your work here will directly influence the performance and stability of our systems, ensuring that millions of transactions and data flows run smoothly every day. Delivery: The Delivery team is focused on innovating and streamlining how products and services reach our customers. In this role, you'll contribute to building efficient and robust systems that support order processing, logistics, and real-time tracking. Your contributions will help optimize the end-to-end delivery experience, making it more reliable and seamless for both drivers and customers. What the Candidate Will Do Contribute to the technical roadmap by developing innovative features and solving complex problems. Collaborate with senior engineers to implement and iterate on ambitious product plans. Work closely with Product, Operations, Design, and other partners to ensure effective execution of projects. Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and technical mentoring to help elevate team capabilities. Provide technical expertise and input to shape the vision for your area, while executing on product requirements. Basic Qualifications 7+ years relevant engineering experience in successfully designing and building large scale, highly available and reliable engineering systems addressing real world challenging problems. Demonstrated experience shipping high-quality product features on schedule and instill a high level of engineering excellence culture (e.g., code reviews, documentation, unit and integration testing). Strong software engineering skills, supported by 7+ years of industry experience in one or more programming languages (e.g. 'Golang', 'Python', 'C++', 'Java') and eagerness to learn more. Experience with large-scale distributed storage and database systems (SQL or NoSQL, e.g. 'MySQL', 'Cassandra', 'DynamoDB') utilizing a microservices architecture Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to write detailed technical documents. Proven ability to develop other strong junior engineers into senior engineers, operating and leading their own initiatives with cross team scope and high impact. English proficiency Algorithm & Data Structures fundamentals, including hash tables, trees, stacks, queues, linked list, DFS, BFS. Bonus Points if Experience working at large companies (10k+ employees) Experience with international stakeholders Uber's mission is to reimagine the way the world moves for the better. Here, bold ideas create real-world impact, challenges drive growth, and speed fuelds progress. What moves us, moves the world - let's move it forward, together. Offices continue to be central to collaboration and Uber's cultural identity. Unless formally approved to work fully remotely, Uber expects employees to spend at least half of their work time in their assigned office. For certain roles, such as those based at green-light hubs, employees are expected to be in-office for 100% of their time. Please speak with your recruiter to better understand in-office expectations for this role. Accommodations may be available based on religious and/or medical conditions, or as required by applicable law. To request an accommodation, please reach out to #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Pesquisador(a) Galênico Nível Pleno - Divisão de Farmacêuticos Estabelecidos/Centro de Desenvol[...]
description: Sobre a Abbott A Abbott é líder global em saúde, desenvolvendo uma ciência inovadora para melhorar a saúde das pessoas. Estamos sempre olhando para o futuro, antecipando mudanças na ciência e em tecnologias médicas. Trabalhando na Abbott Na Abbott, você pode realizar um trabalho importante, crescer e aprender, cuidar de si mesmo e de sua família, ser você mesmo e viver de maneira plena. Você terá acesso a: Desenvolvimento de carreira em uma empresa internacional onde é possível crescer na carreira dos seus sonhos Benefícios como Assistência Médica e Odontológica, Seguro de Vida, Previdência Privada, Subídio de Medicamentos, Desconto para compra de ações da Abbott, entre outros. Uma empresa reconhecida mundialmente como um ótimo lugar para se trabalhar em dezenas de países e nomeada como uma das empresas mais admiradas do mundo pela revista Fortune. Entre as melhores grandes empresas para se trabalhar, bem como um dos melhores lugares para se trabalhar nas categorias de diversidade mães que trabalham, executivas e cientistas. Políticas de trabalho flexíveis que permitem um equilíbrio saudável entre vida pessoal e profissional. Um ambiente onde cada pessoa é ouvida e valorizada. O que você vai fazer Contribuir tecnicamente para etapa de Viabilidade de novos projetos; Desenvolver novos produtos, formulações e processos de fabricação promovendo o aumento do portfólio da empresa, conforme políticas e procedimentos estabelecidos na companhia. description: Our client operates in the performance marketing space, managing campaigns across multiple advertising accounts and continuously testing, optimizing, and scaling what works. Job Description Time Zone : 40 hours/week | Significant overlap with US Eastern hours required (7+ hours daily - 9 AM - 5PM EST) Full-Time | Remote | Fast-Growth Marketing Team Launch Your Performance Marketing Career Are you obsessed with marketing, consumer psychology, and what makes ads convert? Do you find yourself analyzing ads while scrolling Instagram, wondering why some campaigns scale and others fail? We're looking for a driven Junior Media Buyer to join our client's team and help manage high-volume Meta advertising campaigns across multiple accounts. This role is ideal for a recent graduate early-career marketer with at least 1 year of hands‑on marketing experience and exposure to Meta Ads Manager. You'll work directly with experienced performance marketers, learn how winning campaigns are built, and develop the skills needed to become a high-level media buyer. This isn't a support role. This is the first step in a structured path toward becoming a Senior Media Buyer, with increasing responsibility, autonomy, and performance-based earning opportunities as you grow. If you're ambitious, analytical, competitive, and genuinely passionate about digital marketing, we'd love to see what you can do. Why This Opportunity Matters Performance marketing moves fast. Small improvements can create significant results, and the ability to spot opportunities before others do is incredibly valuable. In this role, you'll be at the center of campaign operations—analyzing performance, uncovering insights, monitoring competitors, and helping keep critical projects moving forward. Your work will help identify what's driving results, what needs improvement, and where the next growth opportunity lies. More importantly, this role is designed as a career launchpad. The right person won't stay a Junior Buyer forever. Our client is intentionally investing in someone with the potential to grow into a senior buying role, with increasing responsibility, autonomy, and performance-based earning potential along the way.
